---
title: "6. Channel change, 2011–2020"
---

```{r}
library(terra)

files <- list.files("data/raw/dtm2011", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
files

dtm11 <- vrt(files)
dtm11
```

```{r}
crs(dtm11, describe = TRUE)
linearUnits(dtm11)
```
```{r}
dtm20 <- rast("data/processed/dtm_2020_1m.tif")
area <- vect("data/reach/analysis_area.geojson")

dtm11_crop <- crop(dtm11, ext(project(area, crs(dtm11))) + 100)
dtm11_m <- project(dtm11_crop, dtm20, method = "bilinear") * 0.3048006
dtm11_m <- mask(dtm11_m, project(area, crs(dtm20)))

writeRaster(dtm11_m, "data/processed/dtm_2011_1m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)
dtm11_m
```
```{r}
dtm20 <- mask(dtm20, project(area, crs(dtm20)))
dod <- dtm20 - dtm11_m
names(dod) <- "change_m"
writeRaster(dod, "data/processed/dod_2011_2020.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

s <- spatSample(dod, 1e6, method = "regular", na.rm = TRUE)
quantile(s$change_m, c(0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99))
```

```{r}
plot(clamp(dod, -3, 3), col = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu"),
     main = "Elevation change, 2011 to 2020 (m)")
```
```{r}
usgs <- rast("data/raw/usgs_dem2020/USGS_1M_10_x56y522_WA_PierceCounty_2020_A20.tif")
usgs_m <- project(usgs, dtm20, method = "bilinear")

check <- dtm20 - usgs_m
s2 <- spatSample(check, 1e6, method = "regular", na.rm = TRUE)
quantile(s2[[1]], c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95))

plot(clamp(check, -1, 1), col = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu"),
     main = "Our 2020 DTM minus USGS 2020 DEM (m)")
```
```{r}
options(timeout = 3600)

tiles <- c("x55y521", "x55y522", "x55y523", "x56y521", "x56y523")
base <- "https://prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com/StagedProducts/Elevation/1m/Projects/WA_PierceCounty_2020_A20/TIFF/"

for (t in tiles) {
  f <- paste0("USGS_1M_10_", t, "_WA_PierceCounty_2020_A20.tif")
  dest <- file.path("data/raw/usgs_dem2020", f)
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    message("Downloading ", f)
    download.file(paste0(base, f), dest, mode = "wb")
  }
}
list.files("data/raw/usgs_dem2020")
```
```{r}
usgs_files <- list.files("data/raw/usgs_dem2020", pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
dem20 <- vrt(usgs_files) |>
  project(dtm20, method = "bilinear") |>
  mask(project(area, crs(dtm20)))
writeRaster(dem20, "data/processed/dem_2020_usgs_1m.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

dod <- dem20 - dtm11_m
names(dod) <- "change_m"

# stable ground: flat (< 5 degrees) and more than 150 m from either river
cl_v <- vect("data/reach/centerlines.geojson") |> project(crs(dtm20))
near_river <- rasterize(buffer(cl_v, 150), dod)
slope <- terrain(dem20, "slope")
stable <- is.na(near_river) & slope < 5

s <- spatSample(mask(dod, stable, maskvalues = FALSE), 1e6, method = "regular", na.rm = TRUE)
bias <- median(s$change_m)
bias

dod <- dod - bias
writeRaster(dod, "data/processed/dod_2011_2020.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

s_all <- spatSample(dod, 1e6, method = "regular", na.rm = TRUE)
quantile(s_all$change_m, c(0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95, 0.99))
```

```{r}
plot(clamp(dod, -3, 3), col = hcl.colors(50, "RdBu"),
     main = "Elevation change, 2011 to 2020 (m), bias corrected")
```
```{r}
lod <- quantile(abs(s$change_m - bias), 0.95)
lod

dz <- mask(dod, near_river)
dz <- ifel(abs(dz) < lod, NA, dz)

erosion_m3    <- global(ifel(dz < 0, dz, NA), "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]
deposition_m3 <- global(ifel(dz > 0, dz, NA), "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]

data.frame(
  erosion_m3 = round(erosion_m3),
  deposition_m3 = round(deposition_m3),
  net_m3 = round(erosion_m3 + deposition_m3)
)
```
```{r}
ctg_w <- readLAScatalog("data/raw/lidar2020", filter = "-keep_class 9")
n_water <- pixel_metrics(ctg_w, ~length(Z), res = 2)
wet <- resample(n_water > 0, dod, method = "near")
wet <- ifel(is.na(wet), FALSE, wet)

vol <- function(r) c(
  erosion_m3    = round(global(ifel(r < 0, r, NA), "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]),
  deposition_m3 = round(global(ifel(r > 0, r, NA), "sum", na.rm = TRUE)[[1]])
)

rbind(
  dry_ground  = vol(mask(dz, wet, maskvalues = TRUE)),
  wetted_2020 = vol(mask(dz, wet, maskvalues = FALSE))
)
```
```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tmap)

# load saved data
cl    <- st_read("data/reach/centerlines.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(2856)
dem20 <- rast("data/processed/dem_2020_usgs_1m.tif")
dod   <- rast("data/processed/dod_2011_2020.tif")   # bias-corrected change
lod   <- 0.234                                       # level of detection (Step 28)

# hide change below the LoD, and small change on steep slopes
slope20 <- terrain(dem20, "slope")
dod_sig <- ifel(abs(dod) < lod | (slope20 > 15 & abs(dod) < 1), NA, dod)

# 3 m versions for display, plus hillshade
dem3 <- aggregate(dem20, 3)
hs20 <- shade(terrain(dem3, "slope", unit = "radians"),
              terrain(dem3, "aspect", unit = "radians"),
              angle = 45, direction = 315)
dod3 <- aggregate(dod_sig, 3, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE) |>
  clamp(lower = -2, upper = 2, values = TRUE)

# map
m2 <- tm_shape(hs20) +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "-brewer.greys"),
            col.legend = tm_legend_hide()) +
  tm_shape(dod3) +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "brewer.rd_bu",
                                            limits = c(-2, 2), midpoint = 0),
            col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Elevation change (m)\nred = erosion\nblue = deposition",
                                   position = tm_pos_in("right", "bottom"),
                                   bg.color = "white", bg.alpha = 0.8)) +
  tm_shape(cl) + tm_lines(col = "grey30", lwd = 0.5, lty = "dashed") +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top")) +
  tm_title("Elevation change, 2011 to 2020")

tmap_save(m2, "figures/change_map.png", width = 8, dpi = 200)
m2
```
